title: Observability retention tiering + compliance questionnaire path for SLA upsell
creator: Aisha Nambiar
description:
Objective: Design and validate a gated add-on model for observability retention and a linked enterprise compliance pack that creates a clear upsell path to a premium SLA. This ticket coordinates a cross-functional experiment bridging pricing, contract language, and product gating for mid-market and enterprise customers.

Hypotheses:
- H1: Introducing 3 retention tiers (7d baseline, 30d standard add-on, 90d premium add-on) priced as a small per-GB/month metered SKU will increase ARPU for accounts with >100k tokens/day by 12% within two quarters.
- H2: Bundling a documented compliance questionnaire + SOC2/PCI mapping as a paid "Compliance Pack" will shorten enterprise procurement cycles by ~20% and increase conversion of self-serve trials to contracts.
- H3: A visible SLA upsell CTA in the Console (post-onboarding and on retention change) will yield a 6% attach rate for paying retention customers.

Design & Implementation notes:
- Retention tiers: 7d (free), 30d (tier A), 90d (tier B). Implemented as a namespaced feature flag (gw:obs_retention_tier) with server-side enforcement in the storage service. Metering schema: per-GB/day aggregated, reported as invoice line item.
- Billing: two approaches to validate in parallel: (A) monthly flat add-on SKU (easier to market), (B) metered per-GB usage (accurate for heavy users). Experiment will A/B these with matched cohorts.
- Console UX: Add "Retention" section under Project Settings with clear cost estimate slider and immediate bill impact preview. Add CTA copy for "Request enterprise SLA" that triggers Contract/Questionnaire flow.
- Contract flow: Integrate compliance questionnaire (standardized set) into the Contract Request (CCR) flow. The CCR creates a ticket for Solutions + Legal with pre-populated answers (based on product config) and attaches the Compliance Pack checklist.

Success metrics:
- Primary: ARPU delta for cohort = +12% (30d) and +20% (90d) vs control over 90 days.
- Secondary: Time-to-contract reduction for accounts requesting Compliance Pack = -20%. Attach rate to premium SLA among paying retention customers >= 6% in 60 days.
- Operational: No increase in SLO violations attributable to retention gating; infra cost of retention <= 8% of add-on revenue.

Rollout plan:
1) Build feature flags, retention enforcement, and billing events (ENG). 2) Console mockups and microcopy (DES). 3) Legal + Sales review of Compliance Pack contents and CCR workflow (PM/Legal/Sales). 4) Alpha release to 10 pilot accounts (invite-only) for 30 days. 5) Split cohort experiment (flat SKU vs metered) for next 60 days. 6) Evaluate metrics, update pricing, and prepare GA release + contract language.

Known trade-offs and risks:
- Metered billing increases accuracy but complicates invoicing and CS workflows.
- Longer retention increases storage/infra cost; caching policies and TTLs need careful modelling to avoid runaway costs.
- Compliance Pack content may require legal sign-off per region; this could delay GA in EMEA/APAC.

Dependencies: ENG-6122 (storage-tiering), ENG-6819 (billing-events), DES-302 (console settings UI), LEG-109 (contract language review), SALES-014 (pilot accounts).

Monitoring & rollback criteria:
- Monitor infra cost delta daily; if retention infra cost > 12% of add-on revenue for 7 consecutive days, pause enrollment.
- If pilot accounts report recurring data-residency issues or security questionnaire mismatches >2 tickets/account, rollback the CCR automation and move to manual intake.
